1.title: American Bar Association Ends D.E.I. Standards Under Trump Pressure
1.summary: The group that accredits law schools voted to eliminate a requirement that the schools show a commitment to diversity and inclusion.

2.title: Musk Targets Transgender Issues in Key Midterm Senate Races
2.summary: A political group for the world’s richest man, who is ramping up a midterm spending blitz, began running attack ads against Democrats in Texas, Ohio and Iowa.

3.title: Justice Kavanaugh Blocks Missouri Voting Map Benefiting Republicans
3.summary: Missouri’s Supreme Court blocked election officials from using a new congressional map, saying voters must first approve the district lines in a statewide referendum.

4.title: Israeli Allies Ban Trade With Settlements as U.K. Cites ‘Ethnic Cleansing’
4.summary: Britain, Canada and France on Tuesday announced sanctions on Israeli settlements in the West Bank, with Britain saying Israel had “turned a blind eye” to violence against Palestinians.

5.title: Paul Adams: British-Israeli relations at lowest ebb in decades
5.summary: Israel's response to London's trade ban with Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank shows how important this moment is.

6.title: UK announces sanctions on West Bank settlements prompting furious Israeli response
6.summary: Britain's foreign secretary accuses settlers of carrying out the "ethnic cleansing" of Palestinians, as Israel responds by shutting the UK consulate in East Jerusalem.
